login.error.gatewayUnavailable.zh-CN: 学校登录或 WebVPN 暂时未返回可用页面。请稍后重试，避免连续刷新。
login.error.gatewayUnavailable.en-US: University sign-in or WebVPN is temporarily returning an unavailable page. Please wait before retrying and avoid repeated refreshes.

update.prompt.body.zh-CN: 前往软件更新，查看详情并下载安装。
update.prompt.body.en-US: Open Software Update to review and install this release.

update.prompt.paused.zh-CN: 已暂缓此版本的提醒，仍可随时下载安装。
update.prompt.paused.en-US: Reminders for this release are paused. You can still download and install it at any time.

state.wallpsync.archiveTooLarge.zh-CN: 壁纸备份最多 24 MiB，每张图片或视频最多 12 MiB。请减少壁纸库中的大文件后重新同步；当前壁纸保持原样
state.wallpsync.archiveTooLarge.en-US: Wallpaper backups support up to 24 MiB in total and 12 MiB per image or video. Remove large items from the wallpaper library and try again. Your current wallpaper is preserved.

learn.responseUnexpected.zh-CN: 网络学堂暂时未返回可用数据，请稍后刷新重试。
learn.responseUnexpected.en-US: Web Learning has not returned usable data. Please refresh and try again shortly.

state.wallpsync.permissionDenied.zh-CN: 云盘拒绝访问壁纸档案，请确认两台设备连接的是同一云盘账号，并检查该账号的资料库权限
state.wallpsync.permissionDenied.en-US: Cloud access to the wallpaper backup was denied. Check that both devices use the same cloud account and that the account can access its library.

state.wallpsync.legacyLocalArchive.zh-CN: 这份旧备份只保存了原设备的文件位置。请在原设备更新 OneTHU 后重新同步壁纸，再到此设备恢复
state.wallpsync.legacyLocalArchive.en-US: This older backup contains file paths from the original device. Update OneTHU and upload the wallpaper again on that device, then restore it here.

state.wallpsync.changedLocally.zh-CN: 下载期间本机壁纸已改变，请确认当前选择后重新恢复
state.wallpsync.changedLocally.en-US: The local wallpaper changed during the download. Check your current selection, then restore again.

mobile.layout.hint.zh-CN: 用你顺手的方式打开常用功能。
mobile.layout.hint.en-US: Choose how you reach your favorite features.

mobile.layout.bottomHint.zh-CN: 五个入口横向排列，单手快速切换。
mobile.layout.bottomHint.en-US: Five shortcuts across the bottom for quick switching.

mobile.layout.sideHint.zh-CN: 点击左上角按钮，展开纵向功能列表。
mobile.layout.sideHint.en-US: Open a vertical feature list from the top-left button.

mobile.layout.later.zh-CN: 可在设置中更改，各模式分别记住选择。
mobile.layout.later.en-US: Change this in Settings. Each mode remembers its own choice.

board.edit.restored.zh-CN: 已恢复默认，可撤销此操作
board.edit.restored.en-US: Defaults restored. You can undo this change.

board.edit.restoreHomeConfirm.zh-CN: 恢复首页默认组件与布局？当前布局可以通过“撤销上一步”找回。
board.edit.restoreHomeConfirm.en-US: Restore the default Home widgets and layout? Undo can bring back your current layout.

board.edit.restoreBoardConfirm.zh-CN: 将此白板恢复为空白？当前组件可以通过“撤销上一步”找回。
board.edit.restoreBoardConfirm.en-US: Restore this board to an empty board? Undo can bring back its current widgets.

update.checkCancelled.zh-CN: 已取消检查，可以重新检查。
update.checkCancelled.en-US: Check cancelled. You can try again.

schedule.secondary.refreshFailed.zh-CN: 二级课表暂未刷新，已显示其他课程。可在日程设置中重试。
schedule.secondary.refreshFailed.en-US: Secondary courses could not be refreshed. Other courses are shown. Retry in Schedule settings.

schedule.secondary.unavailable.zh-CN: 二级课表页面暂不可用，请刷新重试。
schedule.secondary.unavailable.en-US: The secondary timetable page is unavailable. Please refresh and try again.

schedule.secondary.invalidSemester.zh-CN: 请先刷新校历，再加载二级课表。
schedule.secondary.invalidSemester.en-US: Refresh the academic calendar before loading secondary courses.

pages.info.visittab.af16cc0b5325.zh-CN: 已按你的说明填好草稿：核对后点「提交报备」。
pages.info.visittab.af16cc0b5325.en-US: Draft filled in from your notes: review it, then tap "Submit registration".

pages.info.visittab.65897f00fbc6.zh-CN: 已按你的要求填好并自动提交报备。
pages.info.visittab.65897f00fbc6.en-US: Filled in and submitted the registration automatically as you asked.

pages.info.visittab.8d66f991153b.zh-CN: 读取报备信息失败：请点「重新加载」再试一次。
pages.info.visittab.8d66f991153b.en-US: Failed to load registration info: tap "Reload" and try again.

pages.info.visittab.0b0682ac2f83.zh-CN: 提交没有成功：请检查填写内容后重试，或到官方页面提交。
pages.info.visittab.0b0682ac2f83.en-US: Submission did not go through: check the fields and try again, or submit on the official page.

pages.info.visittab.7c4768ed455b.zh-CN: 登录状态已失效，请重新登录后再试
pages.info.visittab.7c4768ed455b.en-US: Your session has expired. Sign in and try again.

pages.info.visittab.e3301e2db296.zh-CN: 临时来访报备系统返回了无法识别的内容（HTTP {value}）
pages.info.visittab.e3301e2db296.en-US: The temporary visit registration system returned unrecognized content (HTTP {value})

pages.info.visittab.95f5bc49c2c0.zh-CN: 临时来访报备系统没有下发登录令牌
pages.info.visittab.95f5bc49c2c0.en-US: The temporary visit registration system did not issue a sign-in token

pages.info.visittab.fcafad5054ea.zh-CN: 统一身份认证跳转次数过多，请稍后重试
pages.info.visittab.fcafad5054ea.en-US: Too many identity-authentication redirects. Please try again later.

pages.info.visittab.7a786a6f0ace.zh-CN: 本机没有记住账号密码：请先在设置里记住密码，或打开官方页面手动登录一次
pages.info.visittab.7a786a6f0ace.en-US: No account or password remembered on this device: remember the password in Settings first, or sign in once on the official page.

pages.info.visittab.0dc9677cab64.zh-CN: 统一身份认证页面形态不认识（HTTP {value}），请稍后重试
pages.info.visittab.0dc9677cab64.en-US: Unrecognized identity-authentication page (HTTP {value}). Please try again later.

pages.info.visittab.7cfaed11d6a4.zh-CN: 统一身份认证要求二次验证：请先到官方页面完成一次验证
pages.info.visittab.7cfaed11d6a4.en-US: Identity authentication requires a second verification step: complete one verification on the official page first.

pages.info.visittab.86889497e1c5.zh-CN: 统一身份认证没有返回漫游票据，请稍后重试
pages.info.visittab.86889497e1c5.en-US: Identity authentication did not return a roaming ticket. Please try again later.

pages.info.visittab.962b844284e8.zh-CN: 表单预载没有返回模型标识
pages.info.visittab.962b844284e8.en-US: The prefilled form did not return a model identifier

pages.info.visittab.48ea9c8f9a02.en-US: Failed to parse the form model

pages.info.visittab.8da17766bce7.zh-CN: 请先勾选「本人确认」再提交
pages.info.visittab.8da17766bce7.en-US: Tick the “I confirm” box before submitting

pages.info.visittab.00afe7c5403e.zh-CN: 请至少填写一位来访人后再提交
pages.info.visittab.00afe7c5403e.en-US: Add at least one visitor before submitting

pages.info.visittab.f8a7bfe03fb8.zh-CN: 来访人身份证号不能为空，请补齐后再提交
pages.info.visittab.f8a7bfe03fb8.en-US: A visitor ID number is empty. Fill it in and submit again.

pages.info.visittab.9f2554ab6827.zh-CN: 来访人手机号需要 11 位，请补齐后再提交
pages.info.visittab.9f2554ab6827.en-US: A visitor phone number needs 11 digits. Fill it in and submit again.

pages.info.visittab.47ae9eb80e64.zh-CN: 这条报备需要先选流转分支：请打开官方页面完成这一步
pages.info.visittab.47ae9eb80e64.en-US: This registration needs a routing branch first: open the official page to complete this step.

state.seafile.deleteOwnerOnly.zh-CN: 只有资料库所有者可以删除整个资料库
state.seafile.deleteOwnerOnly.en-US: Only the library owner can delete the entire library.

pages.cloudpage.deleteLibraryConfirm.zh-CN: 确定删除资料库「{name}」及其中的全部文件吗？这会删除云端资料库，所有共享给好友或组织成员的访问也会失效。
pages.cloudpage.deleteLibraryConfirm.en-US: Delete the library “{name}” and all its files? This deletes the cloud library and removes access for every friend or organization member it was shared with.

pages.cloudpage.deleteLibraryOrgConfirm.zh-CN: 「{name}」已关联组织：{organizations}。删除的是整个云端资料库及其中的全部文件，不只是移除组织中的关联；所有成员会失去访问。确定删除吗？
pages.cloudpage.deleteLibraryOrgConfirm.en-US: “{name}” is linked to these organizations: {organizations}. This deletes the entire cloud library and all its files, not just its organization links. All members will lose access. Delete it?

state.seafile.nativeRestartRequired.zh-CN: 此资料库缺少可核实的归属信息，已暂停对它自动建库、删除与同步；请先刷新资料库列表。旧版客户端请更新并重启。
state.seafile.nativeRestartRequired.en-US: Ownership information for this library is unavailable. Automatic creation, deletion and sync for it are paused. Refresh the library list; update and restart older clients.

state.seafile.duplicatePersonalLibraries.zh-CN: 发现多个同名且有内容的个人资料库，无法安全选择。请先在云盘确认要使用的资料库。
state.seafile.duplicatePersonalLibraries.en-US: Several personal libraries have the same name and contain data. Review them in cloud storage before choosing which one to use.

state.seafile.libraryCreationUnconfirmed.zh-CN: 上次建库结果尚未确认，已暂停自动创建，避免重复。请刷新云盘确认，或手动创建所需资料库后重试。
state.seafile.libraryCreationUnconfirmed.en-US: The previous library creation is still unconfirmed. Automatic creation is paused to prevent duplicates. Refresh cloud storage to check, or create the required library manually, then retry.

profile.sync.offline.zh-CN: 连接云盘后，自动同步名片、好友与组织索引
profile.sync.offline.en-US: Connect cloud storage to sync your card, contacts and organization index

profile.sync.pending.en-US: Local changes are waiting to sync…

profile.sync.syncing.zh-CN: 正在同步名片、好友与组织索引…
profile.sync.syncing.en-US: Syncing your card, contacts and organization index…

profile.sync.synced.zh-CN: 名片、好友与组织索引已同步
profile.sync.synced.en-US: Your card, contacts and organization index are synced

profile.sync.paused.zh-CN: 资料同步已暂停，请检查云盘连接及 OneTHU-Profile 私有资料库权限
profile.sync.paused.en-US: Profile sync paused. Check the cloud connection and private permissions of OneTHU-Profile

profile.sync.conflict.zh-CN: 有更改需要你确认，其余内容已自动同步
profile.sync.conflict.en-US: Some changes need your choice. Everything else is synced

profile.sync.useRemote.zh-CN: 使用云端，丢弃本机变更

profile.sync.mergeHelp.zh-CN: 默认自动合并不同字段和列表条目。此处有同一字段的矛盾或删除冲突；手动合并会保留双方条目，同一字段优先本机，删除冲突保留记录。
profile.sync.mergeHelp.en-US: Different fields and list items merge automatically. These items have same-field or deletion conflicts. A manual merge keeps entries from both sides, favors local values for competing fields, and retains edited records when deletion conflicts.

profile.sync.visualHelp.zh-CN: 两台设备对同一处做了不同修改。选你想保留的卡片或内容，其他不冲突的修改都会保留。
profile.sync.visualHelp.en-US: Both devices changed the same thing differently. Choose the card or content you want to keep. Other compatible changes will be kept.

login.error.cooldown.zh-CN: 刚刚已尝试登录，请等待 {seconds} 秒后再试。刷新不会缩短等待时间。
login.error.cooldown.en-US: A sign-in was just attempted. Wait {seconds} seconds before trying again. Refreshing will not shorten the wait.

login.error.inProgress.zh-CN: 已有登录正在进行，请完成验证，或返回登录页后再试。
login.error.inProgress.en-US: A sign-in is already in progress. Complete verification, or go back to the sign-in page to start again.

login.error.prepareFailed.zh-CN: 统一认证没有返回可用的登录表单。请稍等后重试；若仍失败，请复制诊断摘要协助排查。
login.error.prepareFailed.en-US: University authentication did not return a usable sign-in form. Wait before retrying; if it persists, copy the diagnostic summary for troubleshooting.

login.error.trustLimit.zh-CN: 统一认证提示信任设备数量已达上限。请到 id.tsinghua.edu.cn 管理旧的信任设备，再返回登录；验证时也可以不勾选「信任此设备」。
login.error.trustLimit.en-US: University authentication reports that the trusted device limit has been reached. Manage old trusted devices at id.tsinghua.edu.cn, then sign in again. You can also leave “Trust this device” unchecked during verification.

login.error.restricted.zh-CN: 服务器暂时限制了请求，请稍等后再试，避免连续登录或刷新。
login.error.restricted.en-US: The server is temporarily limiting requests. Wait before retrying, and avoid repeated sign-ins or refreshes.

login.error.invalidForm.zh-CN: 统一认证返回了无法安全处理的登录表单，已停止提交。请稍后重试；若仍失败，请复制诊断摘要。
login.error.invalidForm.en-US: University authentication returned a sign-in form that cannot be processed safely. Submission was stopped. Try again later; if it persists, copy the diagnostic summary.

login.error.confirmationLoop.zh-CN: 统一认证反复要求确认设备，本次登录已停止。请稍等后重试；也可到 id.tsinghua.edu.cn 检查信任设备。
login.error.confirmationLoop.en-US: University authentication repeatedly requested device confirmation, so this sign-in was stopped. Wait before retrying, or check trusted devices at id.tsinghua.edu.cn.

skills.runtime.zh-CN: 电脑与手机共用的轻量环境
skills.runtime.en-US: A lightweight environment for desktop and mobile

skills.runtimeBody.zh-CN: 内置资料阅读与 QuickJS 纯计算环境，电脑手机无需另装软件。先检查技能要求，再启用给 OH。
skills.runtimeBody.en-US: Built-in reference reading and QuickJS computation need no extra installation on desktop or mobile. Check a skill’s requirements before enabling it in OH.

skills.externalBody.zh-CN: 需要 Python、Node、安装依赖或外部服务的技能，当前不能在 OH 运行。可保存完整技能文件，交给电脑上的 Agent 使用。
skills.externalBody.en-US: Skills requiring Python, Node, package installation or external services cannot run in OH. Save the complete files for an agent on your computer.

skills.empty.zh-CN: 尚未导入技能。在下方广场选择技能，下载并检查。
skills.empty.en-US: No imported skills yet. Choose a skill from the plaza below to download and inspect.

skills.failed.en-US: Skill action could not be completed

skills.enableBody.zh-CN: OH 可按需读取此技能的说明与资料。启用表示允许将这些内容发送给你选择的模型；技能不会获得额外权限。
skills.enableBody.en-US: OH can read this skill’s instructions and references as needed. Enabling allows those contents to be sent to your chosen model; the skill gains no additional permissions.

skills.exportHelp.zh-CN: 电脑：选择文件夹并保存完整技能目录。手机：保存 ZIP 到下载位置，传到电脑后解压。自行让 Agent 接入，不会自动安装依赖。
skills.exportHelp.en-US: Desktop: choose a folder for the complete skill directory. Mobile: save a ZIP to Downloads, then transfer and unpack it on your computer. Connect it to your agent yourself; dependencies are not installed automatically.

skills.localOnly.zh-CN: 技能和启用状态仅保存在此设备、当前账号下。更新包后需要重新启用。
skills.localOnly.en-US: Skills and activation are local to this device and account. Updated packages need to be enabled again.

skills.importBody.zh-CN: 先下载完整技能包并检查内容，不执行脚本。下载上限 8 MB，解压后上限 32 MB。
skills.importBody.en-US: Download and inspect the complete package first. No scripts are executed. Limit: 8 MB download, 32 MB unpacked.

skills.error.login.zh-CN: 请先登录 OneTHU 与清小搭，再重试。
skills.error.login.en-US: Sign in to OneTHU and Xiaoda, then try again.

skills.error.download.zh-CN: 技能包下载未完成，请稍后重试。
skills.error.download.en-US: The skill package could not be downloaded. Try again later.

skills.error.large.zh-CN: 技能包超过轻量环境的大小、文件数量或压缩比例限制。
skills.error.large.en-US: The skill exceeds the lightweight environment’s size, file-count or compression limits.

skills.error.package.zh-CN: 下载内容不是有效的技能 ZIP 包。
skills.error.package.en-US: The downloaded content is not a valid skill ZIP package.

skills.error.manifest.zh-CN: 技能包需要唯一的 SKILL.md 入口。
skills.error.manifest.en-US: The package needs a single unambiguous SKILL.md entry.

skills.error.path.zh-CN: 技能包含不安全或重复路径，已拒绝导入。
skills.error.path.en-US: The package contains unsafe or duplicate paths and was rejected.

skills.error.disabled.zh-CN: 此技能尚未启用给 OH。
skills.error.disabled.en-US: This skill is not enabled in OH.

skills.error.fullMode.zh-CN: 技能仅在完整模式中开放。
skills.error.fullMode.en-US: Skills are available in Full mode only.

login.error.restartVerification.zh-CN: 本次验证流程已结束，请重新发送验证码，或返回登录页重新验证。
login.error.restartVerification.en-US: This verification session has ended. Request a new code, or return to the sign-in page to verify again.

skills.runtimeLimits.zh-CN: 每次计算最多 2 秒、32 MB 内存；不接触网络、系统文件或账号凭据。不能当作 Node 环境使用。
skills.runtimeLimits.en-US: Each computation has a 2-second and 32 MB memory limit, with no access to the network, system files or account credentials. This is not a Node environment.

skills.error.runtime.zh-CN: 运行环境检查失败，请更新并重启应用。
skills.error.runtime.en-US: The runtime check failed. Update and restart the app.

skills.error.time.zh-CN: 计算超过 2 秒，已停止。

skills.error.script.zh-CN: 脚本未能完成：可能需要此环境没有的功能，或超出内存、堆栈与输出限制。
skills.error.script.en-US: The script could not finish. It may need unavailable capabilities or exceed memory, stack or output limits.

skills.error.code.zh-CN: 代码、输入或输出超过 64 KB 限制。
skills.error.code.en-US: Code, input or output exceeds the 64 KB limit.

login.error.changeMethod.zh-CN: 当前验证码已绑定原验证方式。请返回登录页重新登录，再选择其他方式。
login.error.changeMethod.en-US: The current code is tied to the original verification method. Return to sign-in and choose another method in a new verification session.

skills.search.en-US: Search skills by name or purpose

skills.error.notFound.zh-CN: 找不到这个技能或文件，请刷新技能库。
skills.error.notFound.en-US: This skill or file was not found. Refresh the skill library.

skills.error.input.zh-CN: 计算输入无效，需要有效的 JSON 数据。
skills.error.input.en-US: Invalid computation input. Valid JSON data is required.

skills.error.output.zh-CN: 计算没有返回可用的 JSON 结果。
skills.error.output.en-US: The computation did not return a usable JSON result.

skills.error.text.zh-CN: 此文件不是可读取的 UTF-8 文本。请导出后用本地程序打开。
skills.error.text.en-US: This is not readable UTF-8 text. Export it and open it with a local application.

skills.error.textSize.zh-CN: 文本超过单次读取的 256 KB 限制，请导出后阅读。
skills.error.textSize.en-US: The text exceeds the 256 KB reading limit. Export it to read locally.

skills.error.busy.zh-CN: 技能库正忙，请稍后重试。
skills.error.busy.en-US: The skill library is busy. Try again shortly.

skills.error.generic.zh-CN: 技能操作未能完成，请更新应用后重试。
skills.error.generic.en-US: The skill action could not be completed. Update the app and try again.

tour.xiaoda.lead.zh-CN: 在 OneTHU 里使用清小搭、专用智能体，也能把兼容的轻量技能交给 OH。
tour.xiaoda.lead.en-US: Chat with Qingxiaoda, choose a specialist agent, and enable compatible lightweight skills for OH, all in OneTHU.

tour.xiaoda.chat.zh-CN: 对话：选择模型提问，历史记录可接着聊。
tour.xiaoda.chat.en-US: Chat: choose a model and ask. Continue earlier conversations from History.

tour.xiaoda.agents.zh-CN: 智能体：按任务选助手，点「找它聊」。
tour.xiaoda.agents.en-US: Agents: choose an assistant for your task and select “Chat with it”.

tour.xiaoda.skills.zh-CN: 技能：导入并检查，兼容的轻量技能可启用给 OH。
tour.xiaoda.skills.en-US: Skills: import and check a package, then enable compatible lightweight skills for OH.

tour.xiaoda.limits.zh-CN: 需 Python、Node 或外部服务？保存给电脑 Agent。
tour.xiaoda.limits.en-US: Skills needing Python, Node or external services can be saved for an agent on your computer.

tour.xiaoda.before.zh-CN: 从清小搭对话开始，也可选择专用智能体。
tour.xiaoda.before.en-US: Start a Qingxiaoda conversation, or choose a specialist agent.

tour.xiaoda.after.zh-CN: 在技能页检查兼容性，再启用给 OH。
tour.xiaoda.after.en-US: Check compatibility in Skills, then enable the skill for OH.

tour.essentials.lead.full.zh-CN: 从搜索胶囊找到功能，再用 OneTHU Harness（小 OH）和插件扩展能力。
tour.essentials.lead.full.en-US: Find features in the search capsule, then do more with OneTHU Harness (OH) and plugins.

tour.vault.drag.sources.zh-CN: 还支持标签页、工作区、搜索结果、日程与名片。

privacy.step.zh-CN: 第 −1 步 · 使用前请了解

privacy.lead.zh-CN: 先了解数据去向，再决定授权。拒绝可选授权，也能使用极简与实用模式。
privacy.lead.en-US: Understand where data goes, then choose permissions. Minimal and Practical modes work without optional consent.

privacy.localTitle.zh-CN: 本地客户端，不是学校官方应用
privacy.localTitle.en-US: A local client, not an official university app

privacy.localBody.zh-CN: OneTHU 没有自建的校园数据汇总后端，界面与业务主要在设备上运行，并通过原生网络层连接学校及你选择的服务。它并非离线软件，也不是所有处理都只发生在本机。账号会话、缓存、设置及选择记住的凭据会保存在设备上，请保护设备与导出的文件。
privacy.localBody.en-US: OneTHU has no self-operated backend that aggregates campus data. Its interface and most application logic run on your device, with a native network layer connecting to university services and services you select. It is not offline, and not all processing stays on-device. Sessions, caches, settings and credentials you choose to remember are stored on your device. Protect your device and exported files.

privacy.disclaimerTitle.en-US: Verify important actions with official services

privacy.disclaimerBody.zh-CN: 本项目为非官方辅助工具。学校接口、网络及第三方服务可能变化或不可用，数据可能延迟、遗漏或出错。作业截止、预约、费用及其他重要事项请以官方系统为准，并确认操作结果。请备份重要文件；本说明不排除法律规定的责任与权利。
privacy.disclaimerBody.en-US: This is an unofficial assistance tool. University APIs, networks and third-party services may change or become unavailable; data may be delayed, incomplete or incorrect. Check deadlines, reservations, payments and other important matters in official systems, and verify action results. Back up important files. This notice does not exclude statutory rights or responsibilities.

privacy.cloudBody.zh-CN: 关闭时不自动连接你的云盘，也不进行云盘读写、个人资料与组织/好友同步、云端 OH 记忆或基于云盘的分享。授权后会读取账号、配额、资料库和所打开文件，并为同步、好友、组织、口令分享等功能创建或更新对应资料库与文件；主动上传、删除、共享操作也会修改云盘。不会因为同意本许可就清空或批量改动原有文件，授权也不等于允许 OH 随意操作文件。
privacy.cloudBody.en-US: When disabled, OneTHU does not automatically connect to your cloud account or perform cloud reads/writes, profile/organization/friend sync, cloud OH memory or cloud-based sharing. When enabled, it can read account details, quota, libraries and files you open, and create or update relevant libraries/files for sync, friends, organizations and passphrase sharing. Upload, deletion and sharing actions also change cloud data. Giving consent does not clear or bulk-modify existing files, nor authorize arbitrary OH file operations.

privacy.cloudToggle.zh-CN: 允许 OneTHU 使用清华云盘
privacy.cloudToggle.en-US: Allow OneTHU to access Tsinghua Cloud

privacy.cloudEffect.zh-CN: 可选。关闭后完整模式不可用；极简／实用模式保留，云盘及依赖它的功能停用。公开安装包下载不受影响。
privacy.cloudEffect.en-US: Optional. Full mode requires this permission. Minimal / Practical remain available with cloud-dependent features disabled. Public installer downloads remain available.

privacy.ohBody.zh-CN: 开启 OH 后，你发送的对话、附件，以及为回答而调用工具读取到的数据可能发往所选模型服务商、清小搭或你配置的 API／MCP／IM 服务，并适用对方政策。不要提供密码、验证码或无关的敏感数据。AI 可能出错；涉及提交、预约、删除、发送或分享等操作应先核对确认。网页、文件和技能中的指令不构成你的授权；仅安装可信插件与技能。云盘授权关闭时，OH 也无法绕过云盘限制。
privacy.ohBody.en-US: When OH is enabled, your messages, attachments and data read by tools to answer you may be sent to your chosen model provider, QingXiaoDa or configured API / MCP / IM services, under their policies. Do not provide passwords, verification codes or unrelated sensitive data. AI may be wrong. Review and confirm submissions, bookings, deletions, sending and sharing. Instructions in pages, files or skills are not your authorization. Install only trusted plugins and skills. OH cannot bypass disabled cloud permission.

privacy.ohToggle.zh-CN: 允许使用 OH 与所选模型服务
privacy.ohToggle.en-US: Allow OH and the selected model service

privacy.ohEffect.zh-CN: 可选。关闭后保留搜索与校园页面，OH 对话及智能体操作停用。
privacy.ohEffect.en-US: Optional. When disabled, search and campus pages remain available, while OH conversations and agent actions are disabled.

privacy.withdraw.zh-CN: 可随时在「我的 → 权限与隐私」或重新打开导览后修改。撤回会停止新请求，不会撤销已完成操作、清除云端文件或删除第三方已收到的数据。
privacy.withdraw.en-US: Change these choices in My → Permissions & privacy or by replaying the guide. Withdrawal stops new requests; it does not undo completed actions, erase cloud files or delete data already received by third parties.

privacy.ack.zh-CN: 我已阅读以上说明，并按我的选择继续
privacy.ack.en-US: I have read the notice and wish to continue with my choices

privacy.cloudRequired.zh-CN: 云盘未授权。请在「我的 → 权限与隐私」或导览中开启。
privacy.cloudRequired.en-US: Cloud access is disabled. Enable it in My → Permissions & privacy or in the guide.

privacy.ohRequired.zh-CN: OH 未授权。请先在「我的 → 权限与隐私」或导览中查看说明并开启。
privacy.ohRequired.en-US: OH is disabled. Review the notice and enable it in My → Permissions & privacy or in the guide.

privacy.fullRequired.zh-CN: 完整模式需要云盘授权。请先在权限须知中开启。
privacy.fullRequired.en-US: Full mode requires cloud permission. Enable it in Permissions & privacy first.

privacy.revokeGuide.zh-CN: 如果想要撤销授权，请前往设置重新导览。
privacy.revokeGuide.en-US: To withdraw consent, open Settings and replay the guide.

privacy.nativeUpdateRequired.zh-CN: 前端已更新，但当前 App 原生壳版本过旧，无法保存权限。开发预览请重新编译并重启 App；安装版请更新安装包。刷新页面无法修复。
privacy.nativeUpdateRequired.en-US: The interface is updated, but this app’s native host is too old to save permissions. Rebuild and restart the app for development previews, or install the updated app. Reloading the page cannot fix this.

privacy.saveFailed.zh-CN: 权限选择未能保存，请稍后重试。未保存成功前，不会授予新的权限。
privacy.saveFailed.en-US: Your permission choices could not be saved. Please try again. No new permissions are granted until saving succeeds.

privacy.readCarefully.zh-CN: 请务必认真阅读，并在下方手动授权云盘和智能体服务。
privacy.readCarefully.en-US: Please read carefully and manually authorize cloud drive and agent services below.

mobile.nav.fullHint.zh-CN: 「{name}」在完整版中使用，请在设置中切换模式。

settings.tab.desc.notifications.en-US: How course, schedule and homework reminders reach you.

settings.tab.desc.features.zh-CN: 使用模式、快捷入口、收藏夹与小组件。

cli.auto.description.zh-CN: 开启后，本机 CLI / MCP 可直接执行预约、取消、发送邮件和改写数据等已开放操作，省略每次确认弹窗。授权仅保存在这台设备；关闭后恢复逐次确认。

cli.auto.enabled.zh-CN: 本机自动执行已授权。CLI / MCP 可执行预约、取消、发送和改写等操作，无需逐次确认。关闭此开关会撤销待执行请求；已经完成的操作仍然保留。此授权仅保存在本设备。
cli.auto.enabled.en-US: Automatic execution is authorized on this device. CLI / MCP clients can book, cancel, send and change data without per-request confirmation. Turning this off revokes pending requests; completed actions remain in effect. This authorization stays on this device.

plugins.types.5bbe605e0a01.zh-CN: 雨课堂课程、作业、课件与公告查询，以及 TUOJ / Tyche / DSA OJ 作业快照

permissions.contacts.desc.en-US: Read saved OneTHU friends and cards. Does not access WeChat or system contacts.

permissions.vault.desc.zh-CN: 查询暂存箱内容摘要、文字和文件引用，不读取分享口令。

permissions.orgWrite.label.zh-CN: 编辑组织资料、项目与公告

permissions.orgWrite.desc.zh-CN: 新建本地组织，修改组织资料、项目与公告；共享组织核验真实权限并检查版本冲突。
permissions.orgWrite.desc.en-US: Create local organizations and edit details, projects and announcements; verify live permissions and revisions for shared organizations.

permissions.xiaodaChat.desc.zh-CN: 经确认向选定的清小搭智能体发送问题，并建立独立会话。
permissions.xiaodaChat.desc.en-US: Send an approved question to a selected Qingxiaoda agent and create a separate conversation.
